summary: BOXABL Inc. filed Amendment No. 1 to a September 25, 2026 prospectus supplement, a routine at-the-market (ATM) equity program permitting sales from time to time of up to $100,000,000 of Class A common stock through Virtu Americas, A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, Cohen Company Capital Markets, Maxim Group and Roth Capital Partners. The amendment solely corrects the Form S-3 registration statement filing date (July 27, 2026, not September 27, 2026) and restates the Dilution section, including dollar amounts and a typo. Illustrative dilution uses 25,125,628 shares at an assumed $3.98 price. No special-situation event, board recommendation, premium or deal terms apply.
